definitions.explanation: The quality of being excessively reluctant to spend money or share resources. A literary and somewhat formal word with strongly negative connotations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{吝嗇|りんしょく}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
{吝嗇|りんしょく}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: He lost friends because of his miserly character.

examples.japanese: ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{吝嗇|りんしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紙一重|かみひとえ}→紙一重：20434_kamihitoe⟧で、⟦{度|ど}が{過|す}ぎる→度が過ぎる：19564_dogasugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不快|ふかい}→不快：11386_fukai⟧な⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Thrift and miserliness are separated by a fine line, and when taken too far, it makes the people around you uncomfortable.

notes:
A literary, somewhat old-fashioned word for extreme stinginess. The na-adjective form {吝嗇|りんしょく}な is used to describe miserly people or behavior. While ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧ (economizing) is positive and ⟦{倹約|けんやく}→倹約：09203_kenyaku⟧ (frugality) is neutral to positive, {吝嗇|りんしょく} is unambiguously negative, implying selfishness and pettiness.

The alternate reading ⟦けち→けち：02792_kechi⟧ is colloquial and far more common in everyday speech, written in hiragana or as ケチ in katakana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吝嗇|りんしょく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a miserly person
- {吝嗇|りんしょく}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a stingy personality
- {吝嗇|りんしょく}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: one's stinginess; miserly ways
- {吝嗇|りんしょく}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: a miser

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ケチ: stingy; cheap — the everyday colloquial equivalent
- ⟦{倹約|けんやく}→倹約：09203_kenyaku⟧: frugality; thrift — neutral to positive, implies wise spending
- ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧: economizing; saving — positive, implies cutting unnecessary expenses
- {守銭奴|しゅせんど}: miser; money-grubber — strongly negative, emphasizing obsession with money
